## Requirement

Describe the concrete behavior or integration this change addresses.

## Contract and boundaries

State the affected contract, compatibility impact, and what remains
deliberately unsupported or private.

## Validation

List the exact checks and relevant manual tests performed.

## Alternatives

Record broader alternatives that were rejected and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is narrow and complete.
- [ ] Public behavior has executable tests.
- [ ] Documentation and security boundaries are current.
- [ ] No credentials, generated binaries, or private transcripts are included.
